sections.heading: What is trending: “cyberpunk 2077 update”
paragraphs: “cyberpunk 2077 update” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for AU (snapshot taken 2026-10-21T07:38:37+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 2,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from IGN, TechPowerUp, cyberpunk.net. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “REDstreams — Cyberpunk 2077: Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) is coming!” — cyberpunk.net
“Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 Leaks Early, Brings Console Mods and Dual-Wielding Pistols” — TechPowerUp
“Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Delivers the Gory, Action-Packed Goods” — IGN

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Wed, 21 Oct 2026 00:20:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-10-21T07:38:37+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-10-21T07:39:58+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
